title: Club Nashville 1 Bedroom Condo
description:
"This incredible 1 bedroom 1 bath condo is available for rent at an affordable price! The Wyndham Nashville Resort is located about a mile away from the legendary Grand Ole Opry and the Opry mills outlet mall. Wyndham Nashville is close to many of the city's most popular attractions and about a 15 minute drive to downtown. The resort has 2 outdoor swimming pools, an indoor swimming pool, an outdoor hot tub, fitness center, basketball, picnic/BBQ area, and live entertainment."

Other things to note
Must be 21 years of age to check in. 
Fully refundable security deposit of $150 due at check in with major card. 
These are stock photos from the resort and not of the actual unit. 
Unit of similar size and style will be assigned at check in.
